R1.description: A user-only command name is found in every spelling the issue lists (a trailing ! or ?, brackets, quotes, an = prefix, the other wrapping characters), by the one shared tokeniser, in both the Claude launch scan and the Codex renderer (#247)

R2.description: A command name inside a longer word or path, and every task that names no user-only command, is judged exactly as before; both directions are tested, and every user-only command of the real command directory is refused in every spelling (#247)

R3.description: No new setting, option, exit code or gate; the set of names, the refusal text and the evidence keep their shape; the guide and the roadmap state the rule in place (#247)
